notes: Formed from '공부' (study) + '하다' (to do). It can split with the object particle as '공부를 하다', or take a subject directly with '-을/를' (e.g., 한국어를 공부하다, 'to study Korean').
Unlike '배우다' (to learn a skill from someone), '공부하다' focuses on the effort of studying an academic subject.
